'''Eriadu City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of both [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].

==Characteristics==
It contained the [[Seswenna Sector Bank]], [[Seswenna Hall/Legends|Seswenna Hall]], the headquarters of the [[Eriadu Free HoloDaily]], the private mansions of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] and [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|lieutenant governor]], and the [[Eriadu Governor's Palace|governor's palace]]. It was also the location of the [[Tarkin Memorial Conference Center]].
